model.description: Published first-due polygons where available. Otherwise a directed road-network estimate using road class travel cost from every same-service hall; allows a15second cost tie for overlapping nearby halls. This is training geography, not live dispatch advice.

civicResponses.description: Estimated training assignments only; not official run cards or mutual aid. Eligible modeled cost ties are allocated to balance first-due training coverage.
